releases.name: Release v1.16.0
releases.notes:
## bootc 1.16.0

### Release cadence change

Starting with this release, bootc switches to a **weekly release cadence**. Patch version bumps will be the default; the minor version will be reserved for releases with notable features. See [#2225](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2225).

### New features

* **composefs: Transient `/etc`, transient root, and volatile `/var`** — bootc now properly supports running with a transient (overlayfs) `/etc`, a transient root, and documents the `systemd.volatile=state` path for volatile `/var`. This is particularly useful for sealed/immutable image configurations. ([#2201](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2201))

* **Unified storage update** — The composefs manifest is now a GC root, replacing the legacy `.imginfo` sidecar files. The chain is now: bootloader entry → deployment → origin file → manifest digest → manifest → objects. Old `.imginfo`-based systems are still supported for backward compatibility. ([#2044](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2044)). This is part of heading towards declaring the composefs fully stable - a lot more to come! 

* **`BOOTC_EXP_EXTERNAL_CONTAINER_TOOL` env override** — A new experimental environment variable allows substituting an alternative binary in place of both `podman` and `skopeo`, useful for downstream projects shipping a single unified container tool. ([#2192](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2192))

* **ostree-ext: Reuse prior packing layout with exclusive components** — When exclusive components have already been split into dedicated layers, the prior-build packing layout is now reused, improving layer stability across rebuilds. ([#2109](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2109))

### Notable bugfixes

* **Fix orphaned `/etc/shadow` and `/etc/gshadow` entries before sysusers** — Adds a generator that detects and removes shadow file entries left behind during the migration from `nss-altfiles` to `systemd-sysusers`, preventing fatal boot errors. ([#2207](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2207))

* **install: Don't `fsfreeze` VFAT** — `bootc install to-filesystem` no longer attempts to freeze VFAT filesystems (e.g. the ESP mounted at `/boot`), which do not support `FIFREEZE`/`FITHAW`. ([#2196](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2196))

* **bootloader: Fix systemd-boot installs** — Several issues with `systemd-boot`-based installs are resolved: `bootctl` now runs with `--generic-image` to avoid touching EFI variables, temporary writes that require a writable `/etc` are redirected, and `SYSTEMD_RELAX_ESP_CHECKS=1` is set to avoid unnecessary udev lookups. ([#2191](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2191))

* **composefs GC: Clean up bootloader binaries on finalize** — After atomically swapping staged bootloader entries, GC now runs for BLS/UKI binaries no longer referenced by any entry. The composefs object repository is pruned on the next update/switch. ([#2206](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2206))

* **Rollback fixes** — Staged deployments are now removed on rollback (matching ostree behavior), and bootloader entry sorting for composefs is now correct for both systemd-boot (by sort-key) and GRUB (by filename). ([#2213](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2213))

* **bootloader: Run `bootupctl` via chroot instead of bwrap** — Avoids issues in environments where bwrap is unavailable or restricted. ([#2210](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2210))

* **blockdev: Restore multipath partition number fallback** — Fixes partition number detection from device path for multipath devices. ([#2219](https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2219))

## What's Changed

* Add meetings directory with instructions to find meetings and notes by @mohan-shash in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2181

## bootc 1.15.1

### Changes

The primary goal of this bugfix release is to support installing on Intel VROC systems. We otherwise have a variety of smaller bugfixes, and one effective feature in `--karg-delete`.

Thanks to all contributors!

* fix(install): set DM_DISABLE_UDEV=1 to prevent dm semaphore deadlock in container IPC namespace by @andrewdunndev in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2090
* BLS shared entries GC fix by @Johan-Liebert1 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2108
* test: skip OSCI gating AVC test by @henrywang in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2106
* system-reinstall-bootc: add progress indication during install steps by @judavi in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2091
* cli: Gate IPC namespace entrance on CAP_SYS_ADMIN by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2117
* install: Add `--karg-delete` by @hone in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2105
* cli: Initialize bootc storage before upgrade --check by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2118
* composefs: add a systemd.mount-extra kernel argument to the BLS boot entry by @henrywang in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2121
* fix(deps): update rust by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2126
* install: Enable installing to multi device parents by @ckyrouac in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/1911
* sysext: Add fast path dev flow by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2127
* blockdev: Handle ESP discovery on Intel VROC RAID devices by @ckyrouac in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2129
* Release 1.15.1 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2140

## New Contributors
* @judavi made their first contribution in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2091
* @hone made their first contribution in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bootc/pull/2105
